Copyparty.description:
Copyparty is a lightweight file sharing hub with accelerated resumable uploads, deduplication, WebDAV, zeroconf, a media indexer, image/audio/video thumbnails and audio transcoding. It is served over a single HTTP port and needs no client software beyond a web browser.

The container runs as the owner and group of the config Share, so that account must have read and write access to every Share mapped into the container.

Note: You must add a config file (copyparty.conf) to your copyparty Config [e.g. copyparty-config] Share. Example.

Based on the official OCI image, available for amd64 and arm64 architecture. Rockstor V5.5.0 or later.

3923.description: Port serving the copyparty Web-UI, its HTTP API, and WebDAV.
3923.label: WebUI port [e.g. 3923]

/w.description: The root of the shared file tree (copyparty:copyparty).
/w.label: Data Storage [e.g. copyparty-data]

PYTHONUNBUFFERED.description: Set to 1 to have copyparty write its log messages immediately rather than buffering them, at the cost of a small amount of speed. Set to 0 to keep buffering enabled.
PYTHONUNBUFFERED.label: Unbuffered log output [e.g. 0]
